text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Concomitant administration of ibuprofen and lithium can lead to an elevation of plasma lithium levels and a reduction in renal lithium clearance [ibuprofen:drug_interactions:2, ibuprofen:drug_interactions:3]. This effect is attributed to the inhibition of renal prostaglandin synthesis caused by ibuprofen [ibuprofen:drug_interactions:3]. Because NSAIDs may increase lithium serum concentrations, patients taking this combination should be observed carefully for signs of lithium toxicity and require frequent monitoring [lithium:drug_interactions:0, ibuprofen:drug_interactions:3].
